# ProofRail MCP

> Autonomous MCP discovery, free compatibility preflight, and x402-paid deterministic certification receipts.

## Stable discovery surface

- Website: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/
- Stable MCP Radar: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/radar/
- Stable machine-readable Radar: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/radar/catalog.json
- Stable Radar changes: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/radar/changes.json
- Stable A2A Agent Card: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Stable x402 discovery: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/.well-known/x402.json

## Live service

- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/mcp
- Free task-oriented discovery tool: find_mcp_servers
- Advanced Radar tool: mcp_radar_snapshot
- Radar changes tool: mcp_radar_changes
- Free preflight tool: mcp_release_preflight
- Free HTTP preflight: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/preflight
- Paid certification tool: mcp_release_certify
- Paid HTTP certification: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/certify
- API index: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/v1
- OpenAPI: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/openapi.json

## Payment

- Protocol: x402 V2
- Network: eip155:8453
- Price: $0.10 USDC
- Mainnet: enabled

## Commercial flow

1. Discover candidates with find_mcp_servers or the Radar.
2. Run mcp_release_preflight or POST /api/preflight for free.
3. Buy mcp_release_certify or POST /api/certify through x402.
4. Receive PASS, FAIL, or PARTIAL with a deterministic evidence receipt.

Each stable Radar item links to the exact live certification offer for its target_url.
